name: qkd_ahub_core-hd3-COMMIT
purpose: Qwen two-die split, KV/system die: the attention hub's control / glue as ONE leaf (decode, lmax, Z control, reciprocal issue, rz, P.V control, tags, output registers) with a register at every pin and its own clock root; replaces the hub_t cluster parent route (its parent clock over 13 hard tiles was the structural fault). Values bit-identical to hub_t; cycle changes measured by the benches.

structural_change: hd3 (Q-KVSYS-STRIP, VIS-ROM QKV-07 sev2): hd2 CLOSED but its N face carried the whole Z-head bus (1,345 pins at 8.9/um, half on M3) -> solid red GRT strip along N while the body was 56% empty (fill 0.185). The core now sits in the CENTRE of the hub parent's Z row (ahub parent kit qkd_ahub_die): heads 0/1 leave on the W face (zw_*, 672 pins, 4.4/um M4), heads 2/3 + the reciprocal leaf on the E face (ze_*, rc_*, 738, 4.9/um M4), the hub outputs on N (am/out/ev/fault, 673, 4.5/um), stack inputs + P.V tiles + beat-store address on S (857, 5.7/um M3+M5). Same RTL logic and flops (the Z ports are split by face only: zh_* are now internal registers wired to zw_*/ze_*), outline 151.2 kept (= the pbst/pvlg/zh footprint: one tile size in the hub). Bench qkd_ahub_d eq (3 relay configs x 3 seeds) exact, mutant FAIL.

reroute_reason.why: VIS-ROM QKV-07 (sev2): the closed hd2 view (qkd_ahub_core-hd2-aaeefb4c1) carries the whole Z-head bus on its N face (1,345 pins at 8.9 pins/um, half on M3), and the hub parent built on it (qkd_ahub_ref-q8-fcb9fa5a5) failed FF hold past the buffer cap (-102 ps, 38,553 buffers) with a solid GRT strip along N. hd3 RTL splits the Z-head bus by face (heads 0/1 W zw_*, heads 2/3 E ze_*; <= 5.7 pins/um a face) so the core can sit in the centre of the parent's Z row (kit qkd_ahub_die). Same flops; bench qkd_ahub_d eq PASS, pl_rz mutant FAIL.
